# Spells #519 fixtures

These 100 exact pinned records contain 99 Spell definitions and the excluded
Abjuration folder. `provenance.json` pins every file's bytes; the 28 class files
supply only class-tag context and remain outside review/admission. Reduced
manifests declare these fixture packs. No runtime modules are imported.

`preview.json` is the bounded public importer output with reviewed descriptions,
not an admitted release. Every shipping Spell assessment remains unresolved.
`sheet.ts` creates resolver inputs from those actual imported definitions.
The isolated Convex test installs Magic Missile and Spider Climb only into its
local fixture Character, then exercises public browsing, recording, reading,
previewing and removal as two authorized members and a refused outsider.
Recording these Spells applies no running effect in either ordinary or
permanent calculations. Test-only admission permission is constructed in memory
and never persists; even that fixture still enforces the APG complete-chain hold.
